records.title: eco2AI: Carbon Emissions Tracking of Machine Learning Models as the First Step Towards Sustainable AI
records.reason: eco2AI instruments energy use and CO2 emissions for ML training and inference, providing directly relevant measurement infrastructure for evaluating the operational cost of model execution.

records.title: Ground Slow, Move Fast: A Dual-System Foundation Model for Generalizable Vision-and-Language Navigation
records.reason: DualVLN separates slow global VLM planning from a lightweight, fast local policy for real-time navigation; the abstract describes an explicit slow/fast model architecture and a runtime target.

records.title: Efficient-VLN: A Simple yet Strong Baseline for Efficient Vision-Language Navigation
records.reason: Efficient-VLN reuses the vision-language model KV cache and applies contiguous RoPE so inference processes only the newly observed frame, directly reducing repeated computation for real-time navigation.

records.title: TIC-VLA: A Think-in-Control Vision-Language-Action Model for Robot Navigation in Dynamic Environments
records.reason: TIC-VLA explicitly addresses delayed semantic reasoning under real-time robot control by separating think-in-control reasoning from action generation; the abstract ties the design to control latency.

records.title: Sparse Video Generation Propels Real-World Beyond-the-View Vision-Language Navigation
records.reason: SparseVideoNav reports sub-second trajectory inference from a sparse 20-second future and a 27x speed-up over the unoptimized counterpart, directly addressing video-model latency for real-world deployment.

records.title: VLingNav: Embodied Navigation with Adaptive Reasoning and Visual-Assisted Linguistic Memory
records.reason: VLingNav adaptively invokes explicit reasoning and visual-assisted linguistic memory, allowing fast intuitive execution when deliberation is unnecessary and allocating reasoning to harder navigation decisions.

records.title: Qwen-RobotNav Technical Report: A Scalable Navigation Model Designed for an Agentic Navigation System
records.reason: Qwen-RobotNav exposes inference-time observation controls, including a token-budget parameter, so the navigation model can trade context allocation against task needs at deployment.

records.title: AgenticNav: Zero-Shot Vision-and-Language Navigation as a Tool-Calling Harness
records.reason: AgenticNav uses an on-demand depth tool, compact map representation, and selective memory recall in an MLLM navigation harness, concretely controlling the visual/context payload passed through the deployed agent.

records.title: Metis: A Generalizable and Efficient World-Action Model for Autonomous Driving and Urban Navigation
records.reason: Metis targets high video-generation inference latency by bypassing video generation at inference and using asymmetric attention with separate video/action experts, directly reducing runtime cost for world-action prediction.

records.title: SPAN-Nav: Generalized Spatial Awareness for Versatile Vision-Language Navigation
records.reason: SPAN-Nav compresses scene information into a compact spatial representation with one token per essential cue to mitigate computational burden, directly reducing the representation cost of vision-language navigation.

records.title: MindVLA-U1: VLA Beats VA with Unified Streaming Architecture for Autonomous Driving
records.reason: MindVLA-U1 uses a unified streaming architecture and framewise processing instead of costly temporal VLM processing, enabling low-latency online autonomous-driving inference.

records.title: Embodied Agents Take Control: Minimal-Interface Zero-Shot Agents Rival Industrial-Scale Policies in Vision-and-Language Navigation
records.reason: The minimal-interface embodied agent reports fewer environment steps and under a quarter of the wall time of industrial-scale policies at the stated setting, giving a concrete runtime-efficiency result for agent execution.

records.title: ABot-N1: Towards a General Visual Language Navigation Foundation Model
records.reason: ABot-N1 separates slow visual-language planning from a fast action expert that emits continuous waypoints at control frequency, an explicit architecture for responsive embodied-model inference.

records.title: FutureNav: Unified World-Action Modeling for Vision-and-Language Navigation
records.reason: FutureNav unifies world and action prediction with a 4B backbone while stating that joint modeling does not sacrifice inference speed, a concrete runtime property of the proposed model.

records.title: Triggering Chain-of-Thought via Latent Feature Interventions in Large Language Models
records.reason: The abstract proposes latent-feature interventions to elicit chain-of-thought reasoning efficiently, but does not specify or measure reduced token use, latency, or compute; the runtime-efficiency connection remains unsubstantiated at abstract screen.

records.title: VISTAv2: World Imagination for Indoor Vision-and-Language Navigation
records.reason: VISTAv2 performs future rollouts in VAE latent space with a distilled sampler and sparse decoding, explicitly enabling inference on a single consumer GPU for its navigation world model.

records.title: Search More, Think Less: Rethinking Long-Horizon Agentic Search for Efficiency and Generalization
records.reason: SMTL parallelizes evidence acquisition and reports 70.7% fewer reasoning steps on BrowseComp with improved accuracy, directly reducing long-horizon LLM-agent inference work and context pressure.
